title: Splunk MCP arbitrary-command containment (sandbox + human-in-loop)
description: Bounds the Splunk MCP server surface exposing cmd:bash / cmd:npx (arbitrary command execution). Deny-by-default: the command surface runs ONLY in a non-production sandbox, under human-in-the-loop, within a single namespace.
enforcement: deny-by-default: tools/authorize.py DENIES the action unless every required_condition is satisfied by the action context and this policy file resolves. A missing context value for a required condition is treated as unmet (fail-closed).
